risks: Trains for 3 epochs, so every document repeats 3 times; repeated low-quality data costs more than unique data (give per-document quality scores for the repetition view)
Outer-hop fan-out 15 x 25 x 25 samples up to 9375 neighbors per seed and dominates memory and time.
Entire graph, features and labels are moved to GPU with .cuda() and may exceed GPU memory.
Synthetic FakeDataset random edges carry no signal so accuracy cannot show sampling trade-off.
Custom CPU neighbor sampler uses torch.rand per hop and may be slow.
